note: Manual licence declarations for packages that ship without a usable `license` field. Consumed by scripts/generate-third-party-licenses.ts, which merges these OVER the value found in each package.json (so an entry here always wins). Keyed by package NAME only — version-independent, because the missing field does not come back on a version bump. Add an entry only when you can point at real evidence (the upstream LICENSE file, the repository, or the package README); put that evidence in `evidence`.

packages.evidence: Upstream LICENSE (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openauthjs/openauth/refs/heads/master/LICENSE) — 'MIT License / Copyright (c) 2024 SST'. The published tarball carries no license field and no LICENSE file.
